item.title: Former nurse who broke NICU babies' bones will likely see no more than 3-year sentence
item.description: Erin Strotman, the Henrico County nurse who abused nine premature babies over multiple years, will likely be sentenced to no more than three years in prison, per the terms of her plea agreement.
